title: Enceladus generalized escalation entity (GateCard) v1
description: Wire contract for the escalation entity generalized to all gate kinds (DVP-TSK-967, DVP-PLN-013 E4-W1.2; spec DOC-1931CDD35AAA s1). The ENC-FTR-121 ESC record is the entity; this schema is the GateCard projection @io-kit/gates (DVP-TSK-965) mirrors. Additive over the legacy ESC shape (D9): legacy fields (item_id, status, mutation_type, target_record_id, payload, created_at, ...) stay on the record and are declared optional here. Fields marked 'phase 2' are specified now so the contract is stable and become populated by the decide-hardening work.

GateKind.description: Decision family: acceptance, reconciliation, escalation, tool_call, limit, security, stale_lock. Telemetry family: drift, notice (producer API only; escalation.request refuses them).

Family.description: Derived from kind; a supplied family that contradicts kind is rejected.

State.description: Derived from the legacy FSM status: requested->pending|snoozed, approved|applying|applied|failed|denied|denied_with_guidance->decided, expired->expired (onExpire deny) or superseded (onExpire regenerate).

OnExpire.description: Decision family accepts deny|regenerate only; auto_clear is telemetry.

AuthMethod.description: How the decider authenticated. step_up is treated as interactive_human until DVP-TSK-980 lands (recorded degraded mode, see assurance).

Assurance.description: aal1 = interactive-human ID token only (default); aal2 = a verified method-tagged proof (cognito_max_age) raised it. The hub verifies step-up proofs server-side (DVP-TSK-980); the degraded mode that recorded an unverified proof as aal1 is retired.

ProofMethod.description: Method tag of the step-up proof (DVP-FTR-105 AC1).

version.description: Subject record version pinned at request time (empty string when the requester pinned none).

ResolvedCall.description: Phase 2. A fully bound call (spec R3); callHash is sha256 over the canonical JSON of the other fields.

Decision.description: One hash-chained decision-log entry as surfaced on the card. Every entry records auth_method, auth_time and assurance (DVP-TSK-967 AC2). Phase 2 populates the chain fields.

inputs.description: Decider inputs, validated against the card inputs_schema when present.

DecisionLogEntry.description: One hash-chained entry: hash = sha256(prevHash + canonicalJSON(entry without hash)); seq 1 anchors on 64 zeros. Every entry (decided, executed, execution_failed) records auth_method, auth_time and assurance.

id.description: Escalation id (ENC-ESC-..); alias of the legacy item_id.

proposedCalls.description: Phase 2. Legacy records carry the proposed mutation as mutation_type + payload.

requestedBy.description: Principal that raised the card; must differ from the decider (no self-review). Legacy: requested_by.session_id.

sourcePrincipal.description: Per-source producer principal (think, vagamod, ...). Phase 2 binds it to the authenticated caller.

expiresAt.description: Mandatory for the decision family; max 30d from creation; F-10 defaults backfilled on read for legacy records.

inputs_schema.description: E4-R12. Optional JSON Schema the decider's inputs are validated against (422 on mismatch).

distinct_from.description: E4-R12. Principals who must not decide this card, in addition to requestedBy (403 self_review).

decision_log.description: Per-escalation append-only hash chain (additive field on GET).

decision_log_head.description: Hash of the last decision_log entry.

decision_log_valid.description: Server-side recomputation of the chain on read.

etag.description: Phase 2. Card version the human saw; decide requires it as If-Match.

gateBackfilled.description: Names of fields derived at read time rather than stored (legacy ESC records).

DecideRequest.description: Phase 2 decide body. HTTP carries If-Match (card etag) and Idempotency-Key; both are mirrored here so a client can validate before sending. Server order: auth, self-review, state (410 expired / 409 decided), idempotency, card etag (412 card_changed), subject version (412 subject_changed), callHash (412 call_changed), candidate (422), write-ahead log, execute, record.

subjectVersion.description: Subject record version the human saw; checked against the live subject on approve.

callHash.description: Hash of the ResolvedCall the human saw; recomputed server-side on approve.

inputs.description: E4-R12. Validated against the card inputs_schema (422), stored as decision.inputs.

proof.description: Method-tagged step-up proof (DVP-FTR-105 AC1). cognito_max_age is verified against the ID token auth_time (assurance aal2); step_up is accepted unverified and recorded degraded until DVP-TSK-980; anything else is refused 403.

ListQuery.description: Query for GET .../escalation[/list] and GET /api/v1/coordination/escalations. project_id '*' (or '_') or all_projects=true lists every project (ENC-ISS-773). state and kind accept a comma-separated list. Default single-project behaviour and response shape are unchanged.

project_id.description: Project id, or '*' / '_' for all projects.

status.description: Legacy FSM status filter (requested, approved, applying, applied, failed, denied, denied_with_guidance, expired).
